directive.quote: finish the film repository port so the repo can be retired: settings are rows in the person's lists, read through the door

preserve: check, rows and apply keep their arguments and their answers; the latest stand of an option wins; apply refuses without a pick, refuses an ops file outside the film, runs filmcraft-cli --project P --save run OPS headless (or prints it), and appends the same apply log entry with its blake3 ops hash
is_protected keeps its rule: inside an allowed option folder is never protected, else a protected pattern (fnmatch) protects
allowed_deltas: load_config reads the film's list:settings row through the person's records door and tools/settings request_settings, where it read pick-gate.json

option_decisions and latest_verdict read the person's stance records (tools/where-a-person-stands), named through do-work/stance-id-from-stdin.mjs, where they read the verdict file; picked_stances replaces picked_verdicts
record-pick, record_decision and the pick-label rebuild are not carried: tool:keep-where-you-stand keeps a stand after checking the person's words in their source
banned_substitutions: a decision read from a file the caller hands over
a second copy of the stance identity's fold or hash
a film's paths, option ids or the person's name written into the code

test_refs: tools/put-picked-options-into-a-filmcraft-project/test/pick-gate.test.mjs an agree applies headless on the project and logs it
tools/put-picked-options-into-a-filmcraft-project/test/pick-gate.test.mjs a later disagree withdraws a pick: the record is read as it is now
tools/put-picked-options-into-a-filmcraft-project/test/pick-gate.test.mjs --print shows the exact command and runs nothing
